<documents>
<document id="transfer-limits-basic">
TransferˆlimitsˆonˆBasicˆTheseˆareˆtheˆtransferˆandˆdepositˆlimitsˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan.ˆ|ˆLimitˆ|ˆAmountˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆACHˆtransfersˆout,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆACHˆtransfersˆout,ˆperˆcalendarˆmonthˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆBrookPay,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆDomesticˆwires,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆMobileˆcheckˆdeposits,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositsˆatˆstores,ˆperˆdayˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆDailyˆlimitsˆresetˆatˆmidnightˆEasternˆTime.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆlimitˆresetsˆonˆtheˆfirstˆdayˆofˆeachˆcalendarˆmonth.ˆ##ˆIncomingˆtransfersˆThere'sˆnoˆlimitˆonˆmoneyˆcomingˆinˆbyˆACH,ˆwire,ˆdirectˆdepositˆorˆBrookPay.ˆ##ˆNewˆdevicesˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆandˆexternalˆtransfersˆareˆcappedˆatˆ$500.ˆ##ˆNeedˆmore?ˆLimitsˆareˆsetˆbyˆplan.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆraiseˆthem,ˆevenˆforˆoneˆtransfer.ˆChangingˆplanˆisˆtheˆonlyˆwayˆtoˆgetˆhigherˆlimits.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="wires-basic">
WireˆfeesˆonˆBasicˆHere'sˆwhatˆwiresˆcostˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan.ˆ|ˆWireˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆdomesticˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆYouˆcanˆsendˆupˆtoˆ$5,000ˆaˆdayˆinˆdomesticˆwiresˆonˆBasic.ˆ##ˆCutoffˆtimesˆDomesticˆwiresˆsentˆbeforeˆ3:00ˆPMˆETˆonˆaˆbusinessˆdayˆgoˆoutˆtheˆsameˆday.ˆToˆsendˆmoneyˆabroadˆbyˆwire,ˆyou'dˆneedˆtoˆmoveˆtoˆPlusˆorˆPremium.ˆYouˆcanˆstillˆreceiveˆinternationalˆwiresˆonˆBasic.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆsendˆWiresˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆonceˆthey'reˆsent.ˆCheckˆtheˆrecipient'sˆname,ˆbankˆandˆaccountˆnumberˆcarefully.ˆBeˆwaryˆofˆanyoneˆwhoˆpressuresˆyouˆtoˆwireˆmoneyˆquickly,ˆespeciallyˆsomeoneˆyou'veˆonlyˆmetˆonline.ˆOtherˆbanksˆinvolvedˆinˆtheˆwireˆmayˆchargeˆtheirˆownˆfees,ˆwhichˆcanˆreduceˆtheˆamountˆtheˆrecipientˆgets.ˆWeˆshowˆourˆfeeˆbeforeˆyouˆconfirm.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="transfers-cancel">
CancellingˆaˆtransferˆWhetherˆyouˆcanˆcancelˆaˆtransferˆdependsˆonˆtheˆtypeˆofˆtransferˆandˆhowˆfarˆalongˆitˆis.ˆ##ˆScheduledˆorˆpendingˆACHˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆcancelˆaˆscheduledˆACHˆtransferˆinˆtheˆappˆuntilˆtheˆACHˆcutoffˆtimeˆ(4:00ˆPMˆET)ˆonˆitsˆsendˆdate.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆchooseˆtheˆtransferˆandˆtapˆCancel.ˆAfterˆtheˆcutoff,ˆtheˆtransferˆisˆalreadyˆonˆitsˆwayˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelled.ˆ##ˆBrookPayˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆarriveˆinstantlyˆandˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelled.ˆ##ˆWiresˆWiresˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆonceˆsent.ˆWeˆcanˆaskˆtheˆreceivingˆbankˆtoˆreturnˆtheˆmoney,ˆbutˆtheˆreceivingˆbankˆdecides,ˆandˆitˆisn'tˆguaranteed.ˆ##ˆRecurringˆtransfersˆYouˆcanˆstopˆfutureˆtransfersˆinˆaˆrecurringˆseriesˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆStoppingˆtheˆseriesˆdoesn'tˆcancelˆaˆtransferˆthat'sˆalreadyˆpastˆitsˆcutoff.ˆ##ˆSentˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆaccount?ˆIfˆanˆACHˆtransferˆwentˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆexternalˆaccount,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆWe'llˆtryˆtoˆcontactˆtheˆotherˆbank,ˆbutˆweˆcan'tˆpromiseˆtheˆmoneyˆcomesˆback.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: I'm on Basic and need to send 4k to my landlord by ACH today. Is that possible?
